This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I3, to be carried out every three 
years as indicated by Y3 in the title block.

The first draft 
initiated by eng. 
Ashraf Abd El Hamid Elsayed, tested by eng. Sabri 
Ahmed Elsayed, 
revised by MDEPC Quality control eng. Adel 
Abdel Qader
El-Naggar, 
accepted by eng. Mostafa El-Klmoshy: 
general manager, approved by eng. 
Ebrahim Hassan head sector of Talkha Power station, 
certified by eng. Samir abdel Gilil: general director, and approved by eng. 
Mohammed Nageb: head sector of MDEPC inspection and quality control.
A work permit must be issued.

Wear 
 your safety helmet, shoes and safety belt when cleaning insulators.

Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

items: The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.
Transformer isolation and proper grounding is required.
The unit must be out of service.
Complete tool set.
Safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, safety belt
Digital voltmeter and clamp ammeter.
Dielectric tester, megger
Check that the glass of level indicator is not dirty.
Check the level of the sealing oil in oil cup.
Check visually the extent of any contamination on the bushing.
Check for any loose connection.
Check for oil leakage at any connection.

Measurement of dielectric strength by dielectric tester (more then 40 
 KV/2.5mm).

Measurement of acid value of oil by chemical staff according to MPIS less than 
 0.2.

If the dielectric strength and acid value are below standard to be make the 
 test specified of oil according IEC296.
Measure the insulation resistance of cooling fan motor (more than 2MΩ).
Check the operation of tap changer.
Check the operation of all (switch) annunciators and lamps for control panel.
Check the oil tank leakage and coating damage.
Check that all connections are good.

Check the discoloration of silica gel if the quantity of silicagel changed 
 into pink "qty changed ≥ two third' 
 then you must change all silicagel with a new".

Measure the insulation resistance between windings and between winding and 
 ground with 2kv Megger.
Check for any oil leakage of bushing.
Check for any damage to the bushing.
Clean the bushing.
Check the construction of protective relay.
Check the operation of all devices.
Check the insulation resistance for control cables more than 2MΩ.
Check the water tightness and the tightness of all connection for local panel.

Check the insulation resistance of control panel and terminal box more than 
 2MΩ.

Introduction
This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I3, to be carried out every three 
years as indicated by Y3 in the title block.
Technical Specification:

The first draft 
initiated by eng.

certified by eng. Samir abdel Gilil: general director, and approved by eng. 
Mohammed Nageb: head sector of MDEPC inspection and quality control.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
Wear 
 your safety helmet, shoes and safety belt when cleaning insulators.
Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.
Transformer isolation and proper grounding is required.
The unit must be out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Complete tool set.
Safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, safety belt
Digital voltmeter and clamp ammeter.
Dielectric tester, megger
Work to be Carried Out
Check that the glass of level indicator is not dirty.
Check the level of the sealing oil in oil cup.
Check visually the extent of any contamination on the bushing.
Check for any loose connection.
Check for oil leakage at any connection.
Measurement of dielectric strength by dielectric tester (more then 40 
 KV/2.5mm).
Measurement of acid value of oil by chemical staff according to MPIS less than 
 0.2.
If the dielectric strength and acid value are below standard to be make the 
 test specified of oil according IEC296.
Measure the insulation resistance of cooling fan motor (more than 2MΩ).
Check the operation of tap changer.
Check the operation of all (switch) annunciators and lamps for control panel.
Check the oil tank leakage and coating damage.
Check that all connections are good.
Check the discoloration of silica gel if the quantity of silicagel changed 
 into pink "qty changed ≥ two third' 
 then you must change all silicagel with a new".
Measure the insulation resistance between windings and between winding and 
 ground with 2kv Megger.
Check for any oil leakage of bushing.
Check for any damage to the bushing.
Clean the bushing.
Check the construction of protective relay.
Check the operation of all devices.
Check the insulation resistance for control cables more than 2MΩ.
Check the water tightness and the tightness of all connection for local panel.
Check the insulation resistance of control panel and terminal box more than 
 2MΩ.
